page.notes: The scan is badly faded and stained, and the printed text is nearly invisible. The upper centre seems to hold a title in large capitals, with smaller lines below it, but I cannot read any word letter by letter, so every line is marked illegible and the line lengths are estimates. No marginal notes, running head, page number, catchword or signature are visible. The dark stains and mottling at the edges are not print. A higher-resolution or contrast-enhanced scan of this page would be needed for an accurate transcription.
